alerts.title: Weight Gain & Metabolic Syndrome
alerts.message: Guidelines advise discussing weight gain risk when starting ART and giving proactive diet/exercise advice. Patient reports significant weight gain (17kg, BMI 25.6 to 32.4) and clothes no longer fitting since switching to TLD (TDF/3TC/DTG) 18 months ago. Examination shows obesity (BMI 32.4), central adiposity (waist 96cm), and acanthosis nigricans. Labs show pre-diabetes (fasting glucose 118 mg/dL, HbA1c 6.1%) and dyslipidemia (total cholesterol 228 mg/dL, triglycerides 212 mg/dL). DTG is associated with weight gain. Non-drug causes like diet, exercise, and family history of diabetes should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Discuss weight gain risk, provide diet/exercise counseling, and monitor glucose every 3 months per DTG monitoring algorithm.

alerts.title: Missing DTG Glucose Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines specify glucose monitoring every 3 months for the first year for PLHIV transitioned to DTG. The patient was switched to TLD (containing DTG) 18 months ago. There is no record of regular glucose monitoring during this period. Today's results reveal impaired fasting glucose (118 mg/dL) and HbA1c in the pre-diabetic range (6.1%), indicating a missed opportunity for early detection.

evidence.recommended_action: Implement guideline-recommended glucose monitoring every 3 months and assess for diabetes management.

The patient presents with significant new findings: obesity, metabolic syndrome, pre-diabetes, dyslipidemia, and elevated blood pressure. A clinical plan is required to address these issues, including further evaluation, lifestyle intervention, potential medication review, and follow-up scheduling.
